answer: The 3-qubit GHZ circuit ran on sirius:mock with 200 shots. The circuit was H on qubit 0, then CNOT 0 to 1, then CNOT 1 to 2, then a measurement of all 3 qubits. Job 01a15fa2-25ae-7764-ad42-62e1d602ba63 completed with success=True. The counts are {"000": 200}. A mock backend does not simulate the quantum state, so these counts do not show real GHZ behavior. Here the mock returned 000 for every shot. A real QPU should return mostly 000 and 111. I used transpile_to_IQM, which inserts the MOVE gates that the Star topology needs. The script is at /Users/claytonchancey/Desktop/quantum/.claude/worktrees/wf_3612af23-e49-79/run_ghz.py.
